cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you catch that bus: you said work kept you till six. Why's your taxi receipt timed five?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'll drive you. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left at five. I stopped somewhere before I came home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home after you tell me where you stopped. Sit down; I've got all evening.

mechanism: A acts like a competent investigator, correcting the chronology to prevent B leaving with a contradiction unresolved.
confusable: Simple suspicion asks why; S03 should control the precision and sequence of the explanation.
comparison: A personal timeline interview differs from the other alternative's shared wedding paperwork.
seedUse: Use the timed taxi receipt and missed bus pressure, giving A a concrete chronology method.
